newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas Lodgepole well tests 5,544 bpd.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas Lodgepole well tests 5,544 bpd.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Wednesday its second Lodgepole well flow tested at a rate of 5,544 barrels of 41 degree gravity sweet oil and 1.3 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
The Dinsdale 2-4 well in Dickinson, N.D., was tested from an oil column 140 feet thick in the Lodgepole carbonate reef with a flowing tubing pressure of 450 pounds per square inch.
In early December, the company announced its first Lodgepole well, the Heart River 1.
TransTexas said a third well, the Dinsdale 1-3, is now drilling below 10,000 feet from the same pad.

The company said it believes its net oil reserves in North Dakota from the Lodgepole could be about 10 million barrels of oil equivalent. It has an 80 percent working interest in the tract with private interests holding the balance.
